config.cloud-init.user-data:
#cloud-config

ssh_keys:
  ed25519_private: |
    ${SSH_HOST_PRIVATE_KEY}
  ed25519_public: ${SSH_HOST_PUBLIC_KEY}

ssh_deletekeys: false

users:
  - name: starter-home
    shell: /bin/bash
    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - ${SSH_PUBLIC_KEY}

package_update: true
packages:
  - openssh-server
  - python3

write_files:
  - path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/70-disable-non-key-auth.conf
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      PasswordAuthentication no
      KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
      UsePAM yes
  
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable --now ssh
